p: sons of God saw the daughters: The children of the godly who began to degenerate.
of men that they were: Those that had wicked parents, as if from Cain.
fair: Having more respect for their beauty and worldly considerations than for their manners and godliness.
strive with man: Because man could not by won by God's leniency and patience by which he tried to win him, he would no longer withhold his vengeance.
hundred and twenty years: Which time span God gave man to repent before he would destroy the earth, 1Pe 3:20.
renown: Who usurped authority over others, and degenerated from that simplicity, in which their father's lived.
repented the LORD that he had: God never repents, but he speaks in human terms, because he destroyed him, and in a way denied him as his creature.
beast: God declares how much he detests sin, seeing the punishment of it extends to the brute beasts.
found grace in the eyes of: God was merciful to him.
violence: Meaning, that all were given to the contempt of God, and oppression of their neighbours.
lower: That is, of three heights.
establish my covenant: So that in this great undertaking and mocking of the whole world, you may be confirmed so your faith does not fail.
so did he: That is, he obeyed God's commandment in all points without adding or taking away.
